steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The number of citizens affected by the arboreal Mania entity has risen to 87. All victims are showing symptoms of weakness, including varying degrees of anemia and malnutrition. So far, only Chief has managed to regain consciousness, and the reason remains unknown.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Based on the information Chief provided, this new Mania entity primarily employs mental attacks. The victims' consciousness becomes trapped in the same illusion, where their "life force" is drained.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: FAC frontline units have been deployed to all districts for defensive operations. That thing isn't particularly aggressive and doesn't catalyze any Corruptors. But it's expanding way too fast—just getting close is enough to be affected. We've already lost three soldiers to unconsciousness.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: With its massive size and sprawling branches, pinpointing the contamination source will take considerable time. We're working as fast as we can.
You frown as you study the complex analysis reports, filled with uncertainties and troubling possibilities.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If close-quarter combat isn't an option, are we planning to strike the contamination source from a distance?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...We haven't made a decision yet. All those citizens have their consciousness trapped inside—we don't know if an attack would harm them, and the number of hostages is still growing.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We can only focus on strengthening our defenses to contain its expansion until we either find a way to wake everyone up or ensure we can eliminate the contamination source in one strike—we need more intel, and more time.
MBCC has already contacted Eastia, who denied any connection to Yugu or the wisteria entity. However, they have offered to provide intelligence to help trace this unique Mania power to its source.
The investigation will take time, and perhaps a stroke of luck. Meanwhile, through the monitors, you can see OwO and many other victims still lost in their unnatural slumber.
You struggle to restrain yourself from imagining—now is not the time to dwell on what torments they might be enduring.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Has the mastermind woken up yet?
Nightingale shakes her head, her expression grave. Your surge of anger finds its only outlet in a bitter sneer.
Yes, you brought her in. Thanks to the taleteller's law-abiding registration with MBCC, your shackles led you straight to Yugu.
Or rather, she never intended to escape.
(Switch Scene: Hotel)

According to the tracking team, after leaving her audience unconscious, she walked out of MBCC as if nothing had happened. She returned to town, pausing for a meal and tea along the way—just as she might after any ordinary performance. When she arrived back at her hotel, she even offered a polite nod to the receptionist.

Then, like everyone else in the hotel, she succumbed to the spreading Mania fragrance and fell into a deep slumber. When you arrived, you found Yugu draped in gauze with wisteria vines coiled around her body, a pen in hand—as if she had been earnestly "crafting" some story before sleep took her.
In your hands lies her unfinished tale, titled—Hazy Fete in a Daze: Volume I.
[Special Portrait]
The grand fete was but a fabricated legend. Those seemingly kind-hearted locals were all demons and evil spirits in disguise, luring travelers from afar only to trap them in the celebrations.

And that millennium-old wisteria did not blossom into a fairy but twisted into a malevolent spirit. Whether seeking immortality or cultivating dark powers, she delighted in luring travelers to her Wisteria Pavilion. With honeyed words and feigned affection, she drained their life force in moments of intimate deceit...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Heh... What an "exquisite" tale.
Though written on Eastian paper and with Eastian ink, she was "thoughtful" enough to outline the entire scheme in Disian.
The story remains unfinished, but at the end, she left you a special "thoughtful" message—

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Since you alone have broken free from the fete's clutches and emerged awake from this woven dream... perhaps you shall take the mantle of this tale's protagonist.

You can imagine the expression on her face as she wrote these words. Even when being transferred to MBCC's special quarantine cell, Yugu maintained that same smile—whether lost in pleasant dreams or simply amused at having led you into her intricate trap.
You grind your teeth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...So this is how it feels to be treated as a fool.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Here's all the data we have on Yugu. While her power is potent, she's never shown such an extensive range of influence before. A Banyan team has arrived to conduct a thorough examination on her.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We've also reached out to Eastia for assistance, but the intelligence about the Fete is still too limited. We can't verify what exactly Yugu did to cause the current situation, nor can we predict how it might develop.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, what do you plan to do now?
(Switch Scene: Wisteria Tree)

You gaze at the dark silhouette not far away. The shadow of the wisteria looms like a tentacled behemoth from mythology, its branches writhing slowly across DisCity as they devour the sky piece by piece.
You step away from the crowd and move closer to the peculiar tree of Mania. A ghostly floral scent drifts toward you, triggering fragments of memory that send chills down your spine...
[Flashback (small CG): Three moms and Chief getting dragged]
Though only fragments linger in your memory, that sickeningly sweet yet ice-cold fear awakens once more, growing more vivid with each passing moment.

The suffocation tightens its grip again as your entire body freezes. Within you, blood, air, and sanity are slowly stirred together, dissolving into a sweet syrup that seeps through your skin. Something coils around you, delicately sipping with a small, soft noise.
Every cell in your body screams at you to fall back, to run away—but you must press on.
You step forward, letting your senses become completely enveloped, until the eerie floral scent transforms into a soft chuckle that coils around you.
Heehee...
Then, your consciousness is completely dissolved and absorbed.
